learner_operation: Read coefficients and constants in x,y,z order, choose legal row swaps/scalings/additions to obtain three unit pivots and zeros above and below each pivot, and match the resulting constants to a five-choice matrix or vector bank.

fixed_features.justification: tutorial f74e6075-9c2a-5495-ab21-470711559f2a explicitly scopes the general algorithm to a 3x3 system with 3 pivots; later singular knowledge points are separate
the same tutorial states that RREF is unique; all target practice solutions use three pivots
All 14 practice sources use five choices. Nonsingularity makes exactly one [I|solution] or ordered solution vector correct; varying correct-choice count would change the response contract.

fixed_features.feature: 14 coefficient matrices and their legal row-operation paths
fixed_features.justification: A conservative finite family holds arithmetic workload at the source level. This does not fix the correct bank role: all five answer roles occur with the exact same coefficient matrix and bank. More coefficient profiles are eligible, but are not necessary to prevent a fixed decision cue within these tested families.

answer_roles.role: which full-bank vector is the solution
answer_roles.eligible_variation: all five source-bank members; signed and zero coordinates can qualify once the right-hand sides change
answer_roles.observed: All 5 roles were generated and independently checked in every one of 14 profiles with an unchanged full bank (70 role controls), as well as translated boundary cases.

answer_roles.eligible_variation: any of five choices; it must follow the correct mathematical result
answer_roles.observed: Generator shuffles choices, publication assigns stable IDs, and UI hashes item/field/choice identities into display order. All displayed positions occur in item-identity counterfactuals.

coverage.case: 14 source practice profiles, complete five-member banks
coverage.result: All replay mathematical content, banks, target response shapes and correct answers match; q-10636/q-10646 row-label errors are corrected.

coverage.case: all five decision roles within every fixed coefficient/bank profile
coverage.result: 70/70 correct; each profile admits five different correct choices without changing visible bank contents.

coverage.case: translation boundaries and both matrix/vector targets
coverage.result: All 14 profiles, translations at -3 and +3 and all 5 roles pass exact checks.

Five distinct systems and profiles, 3 matrix and 2 vector targets, roles 3/3/0/3/1. All survive filtering. No tested bank-content rule answers every record, and normalized displayed positions are 1/5/3/1/3.

coverage.case: rejection, requested difficulty, deduplication and learner selection
coverage.result: Read-only publisher preserves all sampled decision cases. Sampler duplicate-rejection branch is tested separately. With positive moderate weight, all candidate roles retain support under modeled histories; source-practice and current-prefix exclusions are explicit.

counterfactuals.change: Within each profile hold coefficient matrix, complete unordered bank, translation and RNG seed fixed; change answer_role 0 to 1, thereby changing the equations RHS.
counterfactuals.expected: RREF constants, selected bank member and dependent worked matrices/narrative must change consistently. Former correct choice must be rejected and new choice accepted.
counterfactuals.observed: All 14 pairs change the prompt and correct mathematical value; every intermediate displayed matrix is independently valid. Native grader tests every bank member before/after. Matrix and vector pair screenshots show the corresponding changes.
counterfactuals.justification: Source GJ operation determines the augmented column from actual equations, not bank identity or template label.

counterfactuals.change: Hold mathematical parameters fixed and vary only RNG seed/answer order. Also vary UI task item identity in position analysis.
counterfactuals.expected: Prompt, worked solution and correct mathematical choice remain identical; ordering may change.
counterfactuals.observed: All 14 seed-only pairs preserve prompt, worked solution and correct answer ID; native outcomes remain the same. Actual UI HTML verifies independent choice ordering; item identity ranges generate all positions without changing answers.
counterfactuals.justification: Source asks for a unique RREF/solution, which cannot depend on layout or seed.
